answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose secret binds their identity; Semaphore membership proofs and RLN proofs let them message without exposing that secret. A rate-limit nullifier permits one message per epoch and scope. If an agent sends duplicates, distinct proof outputs expose Shamir shares that recover its private key, enabling immediate collateral slashing. The lotus, voyage, and horizon are metaphors, not protocol inputs.
